answer: Track who invited whom as an explicit referral graph, then forbid kin from grading or vouching for one another. An attacker's identities cluster like a single grove grown from one seed, densely linked, all timber cut from the same trunk. Honest newcomers scatter like lone shrubs across open tundra. Weight trust only across non-kin edges and a tightly knit sybil grove earns nothing, no matter how many branches it sprouts.
